scope_note: Selected consolidated financial statements and related notes from AMD's FY2023 10-K: Statements of Operations (block-000662), Balance Sheets (block-000674), Cash Flows (block-000686), Stockholders' Equity (block-000680), debt note tables (block-000892, block-000902, block-000925), and shares outstanding table (block-000952). Period catalog uses only supplied XBRL context dates on a source basis: FY2023, FY2022, FY2021 durations and 2023-12-30, 2022-12-31 instants.
gaps: The FY2023 duration start date is taken from supplied XBRL context as 2023-01-01; the fiscal week start described in Note 2 may be earlier, but no alternate source context date was supplied.
No machine-readable numeric XBRL records were available in this source snapshot; evidence selection is based on HTML table blocks.
Revolving Credit Facility and commercial paper program disclosures are in prose and not selected because no balances were outstanding; only core debt note tables are included.
Latest practicable date share count on the cover page (January 25, 2024) was not selected; fiscal year-end share counts are provided in Note 12 table block-000952.
